evals.prompt: Using the core-web-vitals skill: a button's click handler does a heavy synchronous computation and then updates the DOM, all before returning, and INP measurements show it's slow. What should change about the handler, and why does it help INP specifically?
evals.expected_output: Recommends giving immediate visual feedback first, then yielding to the scheduler (e.g. scheduler.yield() or a setTimeout fallback) before doing the heavy work, explaining this lets the browser paint before the main thread is blocked by the computation.

assertions.text: Recommends yielding to the browser/scheduler before the heavy work
